title: Ways to Work With CXWorks: Audit, Sprint or Pod
description: Start with a free AI scan or fixed-price audit, fix the top issues in a 90-day Build sprint. Choose your path.

blocks.lead: A free scan, fixed-price audits and jobs, and 90-day Build sprints.

ctas.l: Book a call to pick the right option

blocks.h: Each step sets up the next.
blocks.p: Each step is small enough to say yes to. Pay-as-you-go jobs sit beside the ladder as a side door: any of them can lead to step 2.

items.d: Automated. Nine Gate score, catalog health snapshot, zero-result search sample and AI visibility check. AI does the work, a human adds a two-line note before it goes out.
Human-led. Finds the earliest failing gate and puts a money value on fixing it. Ends with a prioritised roadmap.
Fixes the top issues from the roadmap: templates, product data, search, tracking, first tests.

blocks.h: Pay-as-you-go: a good idea, with rules.
blocks.p: Fixed-price jobs with a clear output, never hourly billing. Think of a restaurant: the à la carte menu brings people in, but the set menu (a Build sprint) is where the relationship lives.

blocks.h: A job can be pay-as-you-go when:
items: It has a clear finish line: a report, a fixed batch of SKUs, a set of built tests
The scope can be priced up front
It feeds data or quick wins into the bigger journey story

blocks.h: Keep it monthly when the value comes from doing it month after month:

blocks.h: Every route leads to a DCX Audit or a Build sprint.

paras: Every engagement is small enough to say yes to and sets up the next step. Start with a free AI scan, move to a fixed-price audit, then a 90-day Build sprint.

Pay-as-you-go jobs work well for clearly scoped tasks, such as a single template fix, a search tuning job or a catalog batch. Ongoing improvement across several gates is better suited to a Build sprint.
Prepaid credits keep small jobs simple and a minimum job size keeps them worth doing for both sides.

items: Can I start with one job?
Yes. Every pay-as-you-go job ends with a short note on your other gates.
Yes, a minimum job size, so small jobs stay worth doing for both sides.

blocks.p: A 30-minute call is enough to pick.
